name: Filter — date matches
description: Branches pass / fail. Pass when the source date matches the calendar criteria you pick: specific date, relative window (next 7 days), day of week (Mon–Sun), day or month of year, or weekend/weekday.

inputs.name: source
inputs.description: The date you want to check — pick a date field from your request (e.g. departure, booking, dateOfBirth).

inputs.name: match
inputs.description: What it should match — choose a specific date, a window like 'next 7 days', a particular weekday, weekend vs weekday, or a month.

params.name: onMissing
params.description: What to do when the source date isn't in the request.

enum.label: Skip
enum.description: Stop this rule and move on without a verdict.
